description: This file defines schemas and a class for discovering OAuth2 authorization server metadata, including fetching and validating resource and authorization server metadata via well-known URLs and headers.

classes.name: McpAuthorizationDiscovery
classes.description: A class providing methods to discover OAuth2 authorization server metadata using various strategies, including header parsing and well-known URL fetching.

methods.name: discoverAuthorizationServer
methods.description: Discovers the authorization server metadata from a server URL and optional WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: buildWellKnownResourceMetadataUrl
methods.description: Constructs the well-known URL for resource metadata based on the server URL.

methods.name: fetchResourceMetadata
methods.description: Fetches and validates resource metadata from a given URL.

methods.name: fetchAuthServerMetadata
methods.description: Fetches and validates authorization server metadata from an issuer URL, trying RFC 8414 and OIDC discovery endpoints.
